"A ticket to a power bout?" {TargetCharacter} frowns.

"Not to watch: to compete," you smile. "And it's not just any bout: the finest fighters in the cosmos will be there. I know you long to test your mettle against a real challenge."

"They'll go soft on me," {he(TargetCharacter)} snarls. "They always do."

"Hence my second gift." Your servants haul forward a suit of power armour. "Nondescript. Anonymous. The visor is totally opaque."

{TargetCharacter} grins. "Thank you. I've longed for this."

"A goblet?" {TargetCharacter} asks, running {his(TargetCharacter)} fingers over the silver filigree.

"A 'loving cup', from medieval Earth. This was passed around each feast; everyone took a drink. It symbolised their comradeship and hospitality."

"Just think," {TargetCharacter} breathes, "what gatherings this cup has seen... What speeches, what merriment... Thank you."

"What is this, a camera?" {TargetCharacter} frowns.

"A rare pre-Collapse security scanner. It can detect the molecules of all known poisons, toxins and radioactive materials."

"If I install this in the banquet hall... I need never fear poisoning again!" {TargetCharacter} beams. "Thank you!"

"I won't be coy," you begin. "Cruelty is an artform to you. Art requires creative challenges."

"So?" {TargetCharacter} snaps.

"Behind this door is an innocent thing. Raised from birth to believe the cosmos is just and fair; that all people are, at heart, good. That love is the most human emotion. I am giving him to you... to do with as you will."

{TargetCharacter} sneers. "Breaking him will be my masterpiece."

"I know you have a weakness for the minutiae of telecomms transmitters," you smile. {TargetCharacter} immediately sits up straighter. "I've acquired the entire back catalogue of the pre-Collapse 'Signal Strength' magazine, 2045-54. I thought they might appeal."

"Yes!" {he(TargetCharacter)} cries, tearing one open. "The specs for the 2053 Indomnium silicate quadruple-transmission oscillator! Where did you find such a treasure?"

"A vial?" {TargetCharacter} asks, holding it to the light. "A drug - designed for interrogation, originally. Subjects become more appeasing and compliant. I hear you've had arguments with your friends lately?" "Friends!" {he(TargetCharacter)} scoffs. "Always needing something. So demanding! Never thinking of my feelings." "Next time they bother you, use this. They'll be back to their old, cooperative selves in no time."

{TargetCharacter} dons {his(TargetCharacter)} VR headset. "Well?"

"I know how accommodating you are," you smile. "You smooth things over. Conciliate. In this program, you can practice." You gesture to a seated figure in the VR void.

"Greetings!" he smiles. "Begin conversation."

{TargetCharacter} frowns. "The software seems... crude."

"But it has two advantages. First: you can approximate a conversation with anyone: a friend, an enemy. Secondly: you can finally speak your mind, with zero consequences."

{D_s(TargetCharacter)} eyes gleam.

"I know you treasure friends and loved ones," you smile, as you show {TargetCharacter} into the projection room. "I wanted to give you a memento, to honour those closest to you."

A hologram flashes to life: a three-dimensional mural of {d_s(TargetCharacter)} most beloved people, life-sized. Laughing. Smiling. Embracing.

{TargetCharacter} gasps, and steps towards a grey-haired figure. "I thought I'd never see him again," {he(TargetCharacter)} swallows. "The likeness - it's..."

"An egg?" {TargetCharacter} scoffs, running {his(TargetCharacter)} fingers over the gold filigree.

"A treasure of the old world, crafted by a master. Frankly, the seller didn't know what he was-"

"Let's cut to the chase, my {title(PlayerCharacter)}. How much is this tat worth?"

You tell {him(TargetCharacter)}.

"I humbly accept your gift," {he(TargetCharacter)} grins.

"A {houseOf(TargetCharacter)} pin?" {TargetCharacter} fumes. "I own hundreds."

"Indulge me. Centuries ago, the League of Spacefaring Nations established order in the cosmos."

"Yes: the height of civilisation and justice," {he(TargetCharacter)} nods. "I would have been honoured to serve them."

"In their offices hung a great seal. It was eventually replaced, and broken down. My agent found and reforged such a piece, into the pin you hold now."

"A piece of the League...?" {he(TargetCharacter)} breathes. "In the form... of my own House seal?"

"Less a gift," you nod. "More a pledge."

"A book?" {TargetCharacter} smiles. "How thoughtful." "I hoped it might hold special significance. The author of Religio Medici was a lowly doctor of the 17th century. Humble, like yourself - but his humility acted like a door, opening onto endless joyful wonders as he appreciated his place in the cosmos." {TargetCharacter} clasps your shoulder. "I shall treasure his words."

"I'm here," says {TargetCharacter}, stepping into your VR environment. "Where are we?"

"The so-called 'Wild West,'" you cry, gesturing to the desert. "This popular VR program recreated a time of rugged individualism. Here, a {man(TargetCharacter)} has no commitments; no duties. Just the open road, a horse, and the call of adventure."

{TargetCharacter} leaps onto {his(TargetCharacter)} digital steed and doffs {his(TargetCharacter)} wide-brimmed hat. "Mighty kind'a you... pardner."

"A data stick?" {TargetCharacter} asks. "What's on it?"

"The compiled lectures of Aliya Abbas, the engineer who worked tirelessly to refit pre-Collapse facilities for the post-Collapse world."

"She changed the face of the cosmos," {he(TargetCharacter)} breathes. "A brilliant woman."

"This version includes the six-lecture appendix on quantum microfracture compression," you add. "In case that's of interest."

{TargetCharacter}'s eyes gleam.

"A vial?" {TargetCharacter} asks, holding it to the light.

"A whole cargo bay," you smile. "Filled with pre-Collapse medicines of all kinds. Difficult to acquire, but powerfully life-saving."

"What do you want in exchange?" {he(TargetCharacter)} sniffs. "There's always a price."

"That you use it to save your people's lives. I believe, my {title(TargetCharacter)}, that is your deepest wish."

{His(TargetCharacter)} eyes glisten.

You welcome {TargetCharacter}, and {his(TargetCharacter)} closest companions, to {StarSystem}. "Alright!" {he(TargetCharacter)} laughs. "What's the occasion?"

"You've been through so much together," you smile. "Loyal companions. On Earth, such a bond was cemented with a mystical communion." Your staff wheel out a chair festooned with needles and straps. "Now, {firstName(TargetCharacter)}: what design would you like for your matching tattoos?"

"We will remember this bond always!" {he(TargetCharacter)} cheers.

"Your fame is peerless," you begin, flattering {TargetCharacter}. "I've commissioned an expression of this admiration." You unveil the statue: {TargetCharacter}, in the centre, strides across the backs of {his(TargetCharacter)} commoners, rifle held aloft. "A good likeness," {he(TargetCharacter)} nods. "But a statue can only be seen by so many..." "Of course," you explain, "a holographic recreation is also available. So all your people may know your glory."

"An ancient computer?" {TargetCharacter} frowns.

"Late 21st century, running the most acclaimed entertainment of the time. A simulated world of myth and legend; a masterpiece of escapism. Real life - real people - are so tiresome. But with this you have a world of magic and wonder at your fingertips."

{TargetCharacter} sits, entranced. "Maybe I'll... give it a try."

"A vial?" {TargetCharacter} asks, holding it to the light. "A deadly, untraceable poison," you murmur. "Which nobody knows I possess. Now it's yours." {His(TargetCharacter)} face is unreadable. "Whatever would I do with poison?" "I thought you might... find a use for it. And, ahem: what poison?" {TargetCharacter} grins like a snake.

"A book?" {TargetCharacter} smiles.

“A copy of the ancient Tao Te Ching, a source of spiritual wisdom for millennia. Your rejection, my {title(TargetCharacter)}, of material desires is legendary; may this text help you attain that balance fully.”

{TargetCharacter} bows. "I will treasure it always."

"These gifts," {TargetCharacter} sighs. "I've never seen the like!"

"A wheelchair," you gesture. "Crutches of pre-Collapse design. Compression gloves and braces against dislocation. Just because you are frail does not mean you should always be uncomfortable, my liege.”

"Thank you," {he(TargetCharacter)} gasps. "So much."

"I know how dear family is to you," you explain to {TargetCharacter}. "I thought you might appreciate a family portrait."

A hologram appears. {TargetCharacter} stands at the forefront, crowded among {his(TargetCharacter)} close kin.

"Who are they?" {he(TargetCharacter)} asks. "The ones behind us. Wait-"

"The previous generation," you reply. "And behind them, the generation before. Back as far as records survive."

In their hundreds, the figures stretch into darkness.

"My clan," {TargetCharacter} whispers.

"A machine?" {TargetCharacter} frowns. "What's it do?"

"I know you're mocked for your so-called 'slowness,'" you explain. "It's a pre-Collapse neural inhibitor, designed for psyops. Just press this switch and every person in the room will feel their minds clouded - except you."

"Finally!" {he(TargetCharacter)} cries. "Something to level the playing field!"

"Well?" {TargetCharacter} cries, stepping into your VR environment. "What is this place?"

"A sparring ring," you reply. "It supports boxing, fencing - any form of combat."

"I have such a simulation," {he(TargetCharacter)} growls.

"But here, you can customise your opponent - even emulate a real person. How would you like to tear the head off your most hated enemy?"

{TargetCharacter} grins. "You have my attention."

"All rulers desire status," you explain to {TargetCharacter}. "So what better gift to give?"

"What do you mean?" {he(TargetCharacter)} frowns.

"I have commissioned flattering holographic portraits of you. A famous composer has written a zero-G ballet of your greatest exploits. And I've provided enough supplies to make the hydroponics of {homeSystemOf(TargetCharacter)} run with synthohol for days. They're yours to use."

"Why?" {he(TargetCharacter)} frowns.

"Because I would strengthen the friendship between our realms."
